title.purpose: Product names, card titles, modal headings.

label.purpose: Buttons, tags, eyebrow badges, nav links.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default soft brand-tinted glow, used at rest on the Bespoke Lab preview card.

shadows.name: ambient-hover
shadows.purpose: Escalated glow on hover, paired with a -2px lift.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal and carousel entrance easing (ScrollReveal, ProductCarousel).

motion.name: lift-hover
motion.purpose: Primary CTA hover: translateY(-2px to -4px) + shadow escalation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid terracotta CTA with an uppercase tracked label; lifts and glows on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #904642; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #75322f; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #904642; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action; fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #904642; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #904642; background: #904642; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #904642; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip (active/inactive)
components.description: Segmented-control style catalog filter; active pill is white with a soft ring.
components.css: .ds-chip-track { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; background: rgba(251, 228, 215, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(251, 228, 215, 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-chip { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #544341; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-chip--active { background: #ffffff; color: #904642; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Aroma Tag
components.description: Scent/aroma pill with a golden sparkle accent; standardize this shape across product page and modal (see Do's and Don'ts).
components.html: Lavanda Francesa
components.css: .ds-tag-aroma { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fff1ea; border: 1px solid rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.15); color: #544341; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-tag-aroma__icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; color: #cca72f; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Featured Badge
components.description: Solid pill marking a featured product; the one chip using rounded-md instead of full.
components.css: .ds-badge-featured { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #904642; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: White card with square image stage, soft-blush placeholder, hover lift + ambient glow.
components.html:
Velas

Vela Margarida Amarela

R$ 38,00
components.css: .ds-card-product { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.15); overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-card-product:hover { box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.12); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-product__image { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #fff1ea; } .ds-card-product__body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-product__category { font-size: 0.5625rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.7); } .ds-card-product__title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #251911; margin: 8px 0; } .ds-card-product__price { color: #904642; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Rounded-full search field with a soft focus ring in the accent hue.
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px 10px 44px; background: #ffffff; color: #251911; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(251, 228, 215, 0.3); outline: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: rgba(84, 67, 65, 0.5); } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: #904642; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(144, 70, 66, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: Lumina reads like the warm glow of a chandlery shop window at dusk — the kind that makes a passerby slow down and step inside. It's editorial rather than decorative: a confident serif carries the storytelling, a clean sans carries the practical copy, and a single terracotta accent does the work most sites spread across five colors. Nothing here is loud. The site earns its premium feel through restraint, generous whitespace, and unhurried motion, not through ornament. This system explicitly rejects the generic marketplace grid, cold SaaS/tech minimalism, and exaggerated luxury editorial. Lumina sits deliberately between those poles: sophisticated enough to feel considered, warm enough to feel handmade.
keyCharacteristics: One committed accent (terracota-queimada) carrying navigation, CTAs, links, and icon accents — never diluted with a second competing hue.
Playfair Display for anything that tells the story (headlines, prices, product names); DM Sans for anything functional (body copy, labels, nav).
Soft, blurred organic background shapes instead of hard geometric decoration — the site's one recurring atmosphere device.
Every primary CTA lifts and glows on hover — the site's signature tactile confirmation.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracota Queimada is the only color allowed to carry interactive meaning (link, button, active state, focus). Mel Dourado is decorative only.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: Every dark value in this system carries the brand's own warm hue. Never introduce #000, #111, or a cool gray for text or shadows.

rules.name: The Serif-Tells-The-Story Rule
rules.body: If a piece of copy is narrative or emotional, it's Playfair Display. If it's functional, it's DM Sans. Never mix the two roles.

rules.name: The Glow-On-Interaction Rule
rules.body: Shadows only escalate in response to hover/focus; nothing ships with a heavy shadow at rest.

dos: Do keep Terracota Queimada as the only interactive-meaning color; every button, link, and active state routes through it.
Do use Playfair Display exclusively for narrative/emotional copy and DM Sans for everything functional.
Do pair every primary CTA's hover state with both a lift and a shadow escalation.
Do use .shadow-ambient / .shadow-ambient-hover for any new elevated surface instead of inventing a new box-shadow value.
Do default new buttons to rounded-xl (12px); reserve rounded-full for genuinely circular, icon-only controls.
donts: Don't build another generic marketplace grid, a cold SaaS-flat dashboard look, or an over-the-top luxury-editorial page.
Don't invent a new one-off shadow rgba value.
Don't style the same semantic element two different ways on different screens (e.g. the aroma tag).
Don't duplicate the WhatsApp CTA style — standardize on the solid bg-primary treatment.
Don't add another tiny-uppercase-tracked eyebrow badge above a section without variation.
Don't use Mel Dourado for anything clickable — it's a decorative accent only.
